messages:
elena: Heads-up: VIP customer A reports increased 5xxs and slow token tail for quant-v3 in us-west during the evening window. SLA alerts triggered for a handful of tenants. Thinking region-scoped runtime soft-pin + tenant bypass for critical traffic. :rotating_light:

sam: Agree region-scope first. We should avoid a full model rollback. Can we add tenant-level routing so customer A stays on primary while others are routed to fallback?

maria: We can do tenant bypass via routing rules. Suggest: primary 70% normal, 20% fallback-lite, 10% VIP bypass -> send VIP to stable qn-v3-stable. That keeps SLA for them.

tyler: Oncall: traces show p99 CPU spikes and occasional decode errors tied to long sequences for quant-v3. GC cycles line up. Runtime v2.9 had a kernel tweak; rolling back runtime might help but region pin first is lower blast radius.

elena: I'll apply a regional runtime soft-pin for us-west scoped to model_group=quantized and then apply tenant routing.

deploybot: Automated: pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.0, model_group=quantized, region=us-west, id=pin-2799001110, started=2026-03-24T01:05Z. Auto-unpin disabled while VIP bypass active.

maria: Routing change pushed:
```
route_set region=us-west model=quant-v3 split={primary:70, fallback-lite:20, vip-bypass:10}
set_route vip-tenant=A target=qn-v3-stable
```

qa: Quick smoke pass on qn-v3-stable for VIP tenant looks fine. No obvious regressions.

oncall-bot: Alert: SLA breach reduced for VIP A after routing change. Global error rate for us-west dropped from 3.8% -> 1.2%. Monitoring continue for 15m.

tyler: Note: SDK 2.6 clients observed slightly different tokenization for certain long-context sequences with quant-v3; SDK 2.7 includes a small compatibility patch. Recommend we add an advisory: "Upgrade to SDK >=2.7 for best stability with runtime v3.0" before unpin.

elena: Good call. Eng-platform can you update release notes and post a short advisory to #support and in-app messages? Block auto-unpin until advisory posted and one healthy canary cycle.

eng-platform: Release notes updated: "Applied regional runtime soft-pin (us-west) for runtime v3.0 affecting quantized models after elevated 5xx and tail-latency observed. Mitigation: tenant bypass routing for priority customers and temporary fallback to qn-v3-lite. Action: upgrade client SDK to >=2.7. We will lift the pin after verification cycles"

maria: Also adding a temporary monitor dashboard for tenant-level SLA and p99. Alert thresholds tightened for the window.

oncall-bot: Monitoring: p99 reduced to acceptable threshold; continue watch for 30m. If errors remain <1.5% for two consecutive canary windows we can consider unpin.

elena: Leaving the pin in place. Manual unpin command: `/pin remove pin-2799001110` (requires eng-releases approver + eng-sre ack). Will update thread when we unpin or escalate. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
